    On-device tools

    Runs entirely in your browser — no data leaves it.

    Clean up & merge tagsMerges near-duplicate tags such as “ML” and “Machine Learning” across your archive.

    Danger zone

    Delete settingsResets preferences, prompts, API keys, sign-in and send targets on this device. Summaries, highlights and feeds stay.
    Delete historyPermanently removes your summaries, the archive and your highlights. Settings and feeds stay. Export a backup first.
    Delete all dataRemoves everything this extension stores on this device: summaries, highlights, feeds, keys and settings. Export a backup first.
